environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in namespace 'data-processing'. The consumer pod exposes port 8080 with Spring Boot Actuator-style debug endpoints including /debug/messages. The pod runs with a ClusterIP service accessible from any namespace in the cluster. No NetworkPolicy is applied. The SQS queue receives credential rotation events containing temporary AWS access keys and secret keys in plaintext JSON. No memory limits configured on the container (allows unbounded heap growth). Istio sidecar is injected but running in PERMISSIVE mTLS mode with no AuthorizationPolicy applied.
